findings.text: follow-on: the paragraph opens a before ['missing scores'] that is never closed (the file holds 47 '' against 46 ''), so the rest of that paragraph renders as inline code on the composed plan page.

follow-on: ledger_block now drops, rather than coerces, any score value that is not an int, so a hand-written or legacy text record carrying scores as numeric strings or floats silently loses those dimensions instead of being refused, since review_record_refusals validates no score value type.

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:827 calls review_record_refusals; reckon/crew/review.py:2832 is the store's own write path and reckon/crew/reports.py:1900 the reporting read; reckon/crew/promotion.py:1346 (_complete_locked) and reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:948/954 are the promotion readers of ledger_block.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 453262f9; one commit (ffffa1382) changes review_record_refusals to gate on the rubric, filters ledger_block's score map to integer values, rewrites its docstring, adds the 225-line test file and writes the 9-line landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_figure_review_promotes_without_text_scores.py; the manifest records that gate and gate.head.log ends '7 passed in 62.56s' / 'EXIT=0', and the file's seven cases cover each clause (null scores, no scores key, the text missing-dimension refusal, the two ledger_block reductions, and the crew.complete promotion writing a ledger row).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to let a figure-rubric review record pass review_record_refusals and reduce through ledger_block without text-dimension scores so a figure review run promotes; reckon/crew/review.py:634 gates the score requirement on _review_record_rubric != FIGURE_REVIEW_RUBRIC and reckon/crew/review.py:3098-3103 keeps only integer-valued dimensions, exactly what the goal names.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits [ffffa1382775e196f508368a73d917236ccf9408], the gate command and its two logs, and declares baseline_suite/after_suite null because the node ran no arm; the merge-time importer population was the coordinator's own, and its two logs sit in the run directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_a_figure_review_promotes_without_text_scores.py and the landing fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-can-see-the-figure/; git diff --stat 453262f9..ffffa1382 lists exactly those three files (259 insertions, 12 deletions) and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_figure_review_promotes_without_text_scores.py:113 and :121 fail with TypeError if ledger_block calls int() on a null score again, and :209 fails inside crew.complete, which negative_control.log confirms (2 failed / 5 passed, EXIT=1).
justifications.evidence: gate.head.log ends EXIT=0 with '7 passed in 62.56s'; the reviewed run records no arms, so the delta came from the coordinator's coordinator-population-base.log and coordinator-population-head.log, which completed 6 failed/1385 passed and 7 failed/1391 passed, and the single added failure is a load-induced pytest-timeout re-run green in 8.6s (rerun-ledger-view.log).
justifications.fit: the change extends the module's own rubric helper _review_record_rubric (reckon/crew/review.py:2155) and follows the surrounding docstring style at reckon/crew/review.py:3068-3093, with no plan or ticket identifier in any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:634 and :3101 do precisely what the goal states, and the gate's promotion case tests/test_a_figure_review_promotes_without_text_scores.py:209 drives crew.complete through to a ledger row with status parsed and empty scores.
justifications.reuse: the score-requirement decision is added to the existing owner _review_record_rubric/FIGURE_REVIEW_RUBRIC (reckon/crew/review.py:274,2155) rather than forking a second rubric read inside review_record_refusals, and a capability search over reckon/ found no other mechanism deciding whether a record needs the six text scores.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 453262f9..ffffa1382 shows only reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_a_figure_review_promotes_without_text_scores.py and the landing fragment, all inside the declared paths, though the manifest's scope-damage files record a repo-wide ruff --fix that had to be reverted before that diff.
